title: Measuring Large Language Models Dependency: Validating the Arabic Version of the LLM-D12 Scale
reasoning: The paper focuses on validating a psychometric scale for measuring human dependency on LLMs (the LLM-D12). While it mentions 'machine ethics' as a sub-dimension of a perceived trustworthiness scale used for validation and references AI ethical governance (UNESCO), it does not have a primary component of evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, faith, morals, or ethical systems.
